transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I've been struggling with extreme, constant fatigue and exhaustion that has lasted for over a year now, about 13 months. No matter how much I rest, I just feel
Along with the fatigue, have you been feeling mostly down or losing interest in things, or have you been feeling excessively worried and on edge most days?

I wouldn't say I'm feeling down or losing interest, but I definitely feel excessively worried and constantly on edge, almost like a wound-up spring. It is incredibly hard for me to relax, and I find myself getting easily startled by the smallest things.
Did these worries start after a specific stressful life event or major change, or did they come on more generally without one clear trigger?
I honestly can't recall a single specific event or trigger that started all of this. It seems like the anxiety and constant worrying just developed more generally and crept up on me over time.
Have you been feeling worried and on edge more days than not for at least the past 6 months?

Yes, definitely. It has been happening almost every single day for much longer than six months—actually, for about a year and a month now. I constantly feel wound up like a tight spring and get easily startled by almost anything.
Besides feeling keyed up, have you also had trouble controlling the worrying, muscle tension, poor sleep, trouble concentrating, or irritability?

Yes, I really struggle to control my constant worrying, and my body feels incredibly stiff and tense. I also have a hard time concentrating because of how mentally exhausted I get. I'm not really sure about having poor sleep or irritability, though.
Has this anxiety and worrying been causing significant problems in your work, daily responsibilities, or relationships?

Yes, it is causing major problems because I feel completely drained of energy and struggle to get through my normal daily activities. On top of that, sudden, intrusive worries constantly disrupt my concentration whenever I try to focus on my work.

Do you ever get sudden surges of intense fear or physical panic, like your heart racing, shortness of breath, or feeling like you might lose control, or is the anxiety more constant throughout the day?

No, I don't get those sudden surges of panic or symptoms like a racing heart. My anxiety is much more constant throughout the day, with persistent worrying about various daily things and a constant feeling of being wound up and tense.
Have you started any new medications, used a lot of caffeine or other substances, or had any medical problems like thyroid issues that could be contributing to the anxiety?
No, I haven't started any new medications, and I don't consume much caffeine or use any other substances. I also don't have any known medical conditions, like thyroid issues, as far as I'm aware.
Do you find yourself worrying about many different areas of life, like work, health, finances, or family, rather than mainly one specific thing?

Yes, absolutely. My worries aren't focused on just one thing; they seem to spread to everything, including my work, family, and finances. It really feels like I am constantly worrying about every single aspect of my life.
